fields.name: Phase_ID
fields.description: Stable mission row identifier such as M1-001.

fields.name: Mission
fields.description: Mission label such as M1, M2, or M3.

fields.name: Mission_Shorthand
fields.description: Compact branch shorthand such as 1.6.27.Ero.

fields.name: Start_Window
fields.description: Comparative branch window or selected branch label.

fields.name: Primary_Target
fields.description: Candidate body, cluster, or pending selected target.

fields.name: Target_Role
fields.description: Candidate branch role, support role, tag-case role, or consolidation role.

fields.name: Capacity_m3
fields.description: Planning capacity in cubic metres or loop capacity range.

fields.name: Unit_Count
fields.description: Planning unit count or loop count range.

fields.name: Added_Units
fields.description: Additional units relative to M1 base.

fields.name: Source_Status
fields.description: Source-backed, route-ready, payload pending, or awaiting ranking state.

fields.name: Cluster_Status
fields.description: Cluster/neighbour comparison state.

fields.name: Operations_Status
fields.description: Operations planning state.

fields.name: LS_Cognigrex_Action
fields.description: Action for LS/Cognigrex to perform or queue.

fields.name: Asteroid_Workbook_Source
fields.description: Exact source workbook surface or range reference.

fields.name: Required_Input
fields.description: Required upstream data before closure.

fields.name: Output_Target
fields.description: Operations workbook output surface.

fields.name: Owner
fields.description: Agent or floor owner.

fields.name: Next_Action
fields.description: Next concrete action.

fields.name: Dependency
fields.description: Upstream dependency or blocking input.

fields.name: Review_Surface
fields.description: Readiness gate, QA, or publish queue reference.

fields.name: Git_Surface
fields.description: Schema/doc/scaffold reference in Git.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Human-readable guardrails or context.

guardrails: Do not store plaintext secrets in workbook or Git.
Do not infer final target selection from branch rows alone.
Do not infer trajectory, delta-v, window suitability or operational execution from source identity alone.
Keep asteroid database logic in the asteroid workbook and operations sequencing in the operations workbook.
